codeReview.summary: The receipt lifecycle copy and entitlement coverage are solid, but the implementation does not fully satisfy the feature scope because no code change covered the deprecated generic /guest/thank-you alias or validated its intended canonical destination.

issues.description: The feature requires deprecated guest/public thank-you aliases to resolve to the right canonical destinations, but this feature only changed receipt messaging/tests and left the generic /guest/thank-you alias redirecting to /guest/dashboard without any new coverage or evidence tying that destination to a completed booking/receipt flow. The handoff claims the thank-you aliases already routed correctly, yet the reviewed commit 98fc48a7 contains no validation of /guest/thank-you, so the feature is incomplete against its alias-canonicalization requirement.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The reviewed feature relied on an existing canonical rule for the deprecated generic /guest/thank-you alias, but mission shared-state docs only say that /guest/thank-you is deprecated; they do not document why redirecting it to /guest/dashboard is the correct canonical destination for booking-lifecycle validation.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/app/guest/thank-you/page.tsx:6-8 redirects to /guest/dashboard, while .factory/library/guest-routes.md says only “/guest/thank-you is deprecated and should not remain a primary destination.”

sharedStateObservations.observation: Receipt page props include prefetchedStatus from the server page, but the client component ignores it and re-derives everything from the client hook. If this is intentional, the guest-routing/guest-booking shared guidance should note that dehydrated reservation data is the source of truth and this prop is vestigial; otherwise future workers may repeat unused-prop patterns.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/app/guest/bookings/[bookingId]/receipt/page.tsx:112-115 passes prefetchedStatus, but src/app/guest/bookings/[bookingId]/receipt/ReceiptClient.tsx:52 destructures only reservationId and hasSession.

summary: Fail: commit 98fc48a7 improves receipt entitlement and lifecycle-specific confirmed/pending/cancelled messaging, but it does not implement or verify the full thank-you alias canonicalization scope because the deprecated /guest/thank-you alias remains unreviewed and unsupported by feature-specific evidence.
